title: Pooling Around | Benchmark Management Vacation Rental
meta_description: Pooling Around is a 4.00 bedroom, 4.00 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: Looking for a beach retreat that combines space, comfort, and unbeatable access to Seacrest’s best features? Pooling Around, formerly known as "Cool Breeze," sits directly along the iconic 12,000-square-foot lagoon pool, offering front-row views and convenient access to one of the largest and most impressive pools on 30A. Just a 5-minute stroll from the pristine shoreline, this spacious, dog-friendly home accommodates up to 12 guests and is perfect for families, groups, or furry friends eager to enjoy all that Seacrest Beach has to offer.Step inside and you’ll find a bright, open layout designed for comfort and connection. The main living area flows seamlessly into a well-equipped kitchen featuring a coffee maker, toaster, microwave, and full-size refrigerator—ideal for preparing meals for any size group. The home offers multiple dining options, including a main dining area with six chairs, an additional round table with four chairs, and a breakfast bar with two high chairs. Whether you’re enjoying coffee on the balcony overlooking the palm-lined pool or sharing stories around the dining tables, every space is set for memorable moments together.A unique feature of this home is its separate downstairs apartment, accessible through the garage area or from a private side entrance that leads directly outdoors. This lower-level space includes its own kitchen, bedroom, and bathroom, making it a great option for guests who prefer extra privacy or wish to avoid stairs. Everything needed for a comfortable stay is available on this level. The downstairs area can also be locked, offering added security for parents or guests who want to monitor access.Sleeping Arrangements:* 1st Floor (Private Apartment): 1 Queen bed, TV, full kitchen, private bathroom with shower/tub combo, separate side entrance through garage.* 2nd Floor, Bunk Room: 2 sets of twin-over-full bunks (sleeps 6), TV, hallway full bathroom with shower/tub combo (this bathroom serves the entire 2nd floor).* 3rd Floor, Guest Bedroom: 1 King bed, TV, private bathroom with shower/tub combo.* 3rd Floor, Primary Suite: 1 King bed, TV, workspace furniture, private bathroom with dual sinks, separate shower and tub, and private covered balcony access.For added fun and convenience, this home provides six bikes for exploring the area, beach essentials including chairs located in the garage, and an air hockey table for indoor entertainment and family fun.Seacrest Beach II:The showstopper of the area is the 12,000 square-foot lagoon pool. With a waterfall, fountain, and children's splash area we know you'll find your perfect pool day at Seacrest. Surrounded by palm trees and poolside loungers, it might be hard to split your time between this pool and the beautiful Gulf.Local Experiences & Attractions:From this prime location, you’re minutes from the unique offerings of 30A. Explore Shades, George's Alys Beach, and Peddlers Pavilion, or enjoy Rosemary Downtown with The Pearl and Sugar Shack. Stop by 30Avenue for upscale dining at Amigos, Amicis, Idyll Proper, and fun at Attycat's Arcade. Nearby Watersound Towncenter features Publix, Ambrosia, Village Market, Nigels, Sweet Henriettas, and The Big Chill on 30A (formerly Hub30A). Each stop gives you a chance to taste local flavors, shop unique boutiques, and experience the culture of 30A.Your stay at Pooling Around comes with Xplorie’s best activities! one ticket per day, per activity! (over $800 in nightly value) Tee off at Emerald Bay or Regatta Bay, zip through Baytowne Adventure Zone, and sail on the Sea Blaster Dolphin Cruise. Enjoy Big Kahuna’s Water Park, Black Light Mini Golf, and scenic bike rides with complimentary rentals. Explore 30A with ease and adventure!Additional Information:* Snowbird Friendly!* Parking for 2 cars only.* Dog Friendly: One dog (up to 35 lbs) allowed with a non-refundable pet fee. Please contact us if bringing a pet. See rental policies for details.An initial starter kit of amenities are provided for all guests. For the kitchen this includes: 1 roll of paper towels, 1 dish sponge, 1 dish soap, 2 dishwasher pods, and 1 liner for each trashcan. For each bathroom it includes: 1 roll of toilet paper, 1 set of soap/body wash/shampoo/conditioner/lotion. For towels you will receive: 1 body towel/1 washcloth per guest and 2 hand towels per bathroom, plus 2 washing machine pods.
